notes.title: 24-05-13 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug.

notes.title: Finally! a patch with collection items has been released!
notes.notes:
Now, explore the map and collect items with stories!

A total of 27 items have been added, and more will be added along with the hard mode later.
Other than this, I fixed some bugs and UI.

notes.title: 24-03-14 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- I have addressed an issue where a green object exploding upon collision with a propeller was sporadically spawning in abnormal locations.
- Certain parts of the tutorial that were difficult to understand have been replaced with videos for a more intuitive experience.

Our upcoming discount event will commence shortly. I appreciate your interest.

* The collection part is still undergoing development. I kindly ask for your patience a little longer.

notes.title: 2024-02-19 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Modified the UI.
- Revised some parts of the story.
- Improved visibility in certain less noticeable sections.
- Adjusted some sound elements.
- Intro and outro have been added, and the scoreboard is now displayed upon clearing.
- Fixed bugs causing unusual behavior in certain segments.
- Updated the tutorial.
- Added Simplified and Traditional Chinese languages.

# The next update will feature the addition of collectible items.
